acceleration.viewed: H192 at 200/400/600/800 ms, plus H64 at 600 ms, for both versions
acceleration.observations: The R6 ray support is smaller and additional staggered glints appear on the retained cyan carriers and at the receiving rim. Individual points can overlap; the CPU peak of 12 is not a measured count of separately visible stars. H64 is faint and limits exact spatial-count acceptance.

humanTransmutation.viewed: H128 at 450/650/850/1050 ms, plus H64 at 450 ms, for both versions
humanTransmutation.observations: At 450 ms the former long dominant rays become shorter, multiple local glints around fixed material. At 650 and 850 ms shorter glints follow higher fixation regions. The original reconstruction remains. At 1050 ms neither version retains unrelated glints. Small-view individual-point counting remains limited; 25 registered points and peak 9 active are source/timing facts, not 25 simultaneously visible stars.

publicationDecision: Technically replayable R6 candidates may be listed with partial quality and their exact technical scope. They are not adopted automatically. Public-parent selection and delivery verification follow publication.
limits: Static phase views are not a complete visual-quality review of natural playback. Ordinary SFX listening, iPad Safari and main-game integration were not established.
